errors.text_span: които сравняват три различни ценови стратегии спрямо тяхната ефективност
errors.evidence: The description claims the chart compares strategies based on their 'effectiveness'. While the figure caption is 'Most profitable pricing strategy', the chart itself only shows percentage values for each strategy without defining the metric (e.g., percentage of companies using the strategy, percentage of survey respondents who believe it is most effective). Stating it measures 'effectiveness' is an interpretation of the chart's purpose, not a direct description of what the axes represent.
The description claims that the y-axis has a label 'Процент'. The image shows that the y-axis has numerical tick marks but no textual label.
